description: Stamp page numbers onto every page of a PDF — choose position, format and starting number.

faqs.a: The numbers are drawn as real PDF text on each page with the standard Helvetica font, so they stay crisp at any zoom and survive printing.
faqs.q: Are the numbers real text or images?

faqs.a: Yes — set the start number to 2 to skip numbering a cover page, or to any value your document needs.
faqs.q: Can I start numbering from a number other than 1?

faqs.a: No. Your PDF is processed entirely in your browser with PDF-Lib; it is never uploaded.

howto: Pick the position (top/bottom × left/center/right) and the number format.
Set the start number and font size.
Click "Add page numbers" and download the stamped PDF.
title: PDF Page Numberer
